narrativeBlocks.title: The Otherworld is close
narrativeBlocks.body: In the Mabinogion, the supernatural is not distant. Encounters with otherworldly figures test kingship, promises, and identity.

narrativeBlocks.title: A Welsh medieval tradition
narrativeBlocks.body: The Mabinogion preserves Welsh tales in translation. It gives us romance, magic, and heroic politics rather than a systematic pantheon.

narrativeBlocks.title: What the second source adds
narrativeBlocks.body: The additional corpus record gives a second lens on the same tradition. Compare it with the first source instead of treating either as a complete canon.

narrativeBlocks.title: How to read this evidence
narrativeBlocks.body: Ask what kind of source this is, who translated or organized it, what it can actually prove, and whether another text preserves a different version.

narrativeBlocks.title: Rule is tested
narrativeBlocks.body: Pwyll’s story makes leadership depend on restraint, honor, and navigating powers beyond ordinary human law.
